meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, select or create the agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把首个智能体接入私信频道并发出欢迎消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你刚布置好智能体服务,想快速接通私信频道。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your first agent to a DM channel and send a welcome message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just set up an agent service and want to quickly wire it to a DM channel.

howto.what: Claude 会引导你创建首个 NanoClaw 智能体并接入私聊频道：选定频道、填写你的用户 ID 和显示名，然后创建智能体，让它给你发一条欢迎私信来验证配置。重复执行也安全。
howto.when: 在频道凭据已配置、服务已运行后，当你想创建第一个 NanoClaw 智能体并收到它的欢迎私信时，即可开始。

say.text: 帮我在 Discord 创建第一个 NanoClaw 智能体，并给我发欢迎私信。
say.note: Claude 会先选频道，再问你的用户ID和显示名。

say.text: 我要在 Telegram 初始化新智能体，欢迎消息发到我的私聊。
say.note: 若你不想先私信机器人，可走配对码流程。

say.text: 凭据已配置好，请执行首个智能体初始化并验证欢迎私信。
say.note: Claude 会运行脚本并等你确认收到。

howto.what_en: Claude guides the operator through onboarding the first NanoClaw agent for a DM channel: pick a channel, supply a user id and display name, create the agent, and verify delivery by having it send a welcome DM to the operator. Safe to rerun.
howto.when_en: Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running, when the operator wants to create the first NanoClaw agent and receive a welcome DM through a channel.

say_en.text: Create my first NanoClaw agent on Discord and send me a welcome DM.
say_en.note: Claude asks for your user id and display name.

say_en.text: Initialize a new agent on Telegram and send the welcome message to my DM.
say_en.note: If you don't want to DM first, use the pairing-code flow.

say_en.text: Credentials are ready. Init my first agent and check the welcome DM lands.
say_en.note: Claude runs the init script and waits for your confirmation.
